text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Alright! No dangerous debris on the beach 
today either!

Hokko Tarumae and Eishin Flash also 
carried out their duties as the 
"Environment Committee." It was an 
important job keeping the training camp 
and surrounding area tidy!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for helping pick up the rocks. 
The air temperature, water temperature, 
and weather were all normal.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Ah, it looks like 
there's construction on the outer course, 
so I'll send out a general announcement to 
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
My, you even looked into that...! As 
expected of you, that's a huge help.
choice_data_list:
(They're both so diligent every single 
morning!)

text_block_list.text:
It is by no means an easy task. Yet, such 
work often goes unnoticed. To everyone, 
it's just 'taken for granted'—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
There's like, noooothin' on this beach at 
all~♪ No trash either, it's super clean. 
Pure nature. Totally peaceful~.
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to daily care, though...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —To-tal-ly~~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco knows! This beauty is not something 
to be taken for granted☆"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
After all, Tarumae-chan and Flash-san are 
on the environmental committee this year♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, nobody ever notices. 
Flash-san is just so capable that it 
always ends up like this.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's right~! Before you know it, she 
just nonchalantly finishes it all! Even 
Falco doesn't notice sometimes!

It's the same... with Hokko Tarumae, too. 
She does things properly even when 
nobody's watching. Always, consistently, 
giving it her all...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's a bit frustrating, isn't it...? Even 
though they're both so amazing.

I gave a deep nod. There was no way it 
wasn't tough. If no one else noticed, then 
at the very least, since I knew the 
truth...!
choice_data_list: Oh yeah, lend me your ear for a second!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"What's going on...? Wow, that sounds 
great♪ Let Falco help out too—!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Falco-saaan, I'm here~! Huh, is she not 
here yet?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"What kind of job do you want to ask of me 
here...? And in a swimsuit, no less—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oooo! SURPRIIISE!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Eep! Falco-san!? Trainer too...! I thought 
today was your day off—wait, what is 
this...?!

Under the parasol were picnic mats and 
lounge chairs. Drinks, bento boxes, paper 
fans, and chilled sweets were all laid out 
ready.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! It's a humble beach picnic♪ Please 
relax and take it easy today~☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Uh, wha... Does that mean, um...?
choice_data_list:
I just wanted to show my appreciation for 
all your hard work...!

I wanted to show my appreciation for all 
of you...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Show appreciation...? For what? Did we do 
something?
choice_data_list: I am! Always, lots and lots!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, Falco and the others are watching. 
So... just let yourself be healed for 
today☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...! Both of you...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Ehehe, thank you very much. Well 
then, don't mind if I do!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Mmh~~~~! Slept like a baby...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, is the timing... okay? You shouldn't 
have that much work today, though...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I'm completely fine! Still got plenty of 
energy☆ You really are such a stickler~."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, that's just the kind of 
disposition we have.

Whether playing or napping, work schedules 
linger in the back of their minds. That is 
simply who they are. Still, they seem to 
have refreshed themselves!
choice_data_list:
Starting tomorrow, I'll do my best again, 
just being myself!

Maybe I should just be late today... or 
something...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's true!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Knowing there are people out there who are 
properly watching my hard work... It just 
fills me with energy!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"It's just in my nature—if I'm not doing 
some kind of work, I can't really settle 
down!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
True to myself... huh. It might be a bit 
awkward as a local idol persona, but what 
you see is what you get. I'll do my best 
at my own pace!

text_block_list.name: Tarumae & Flash
text_block_list.text: You can't do that!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...! Pfft, fufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, shall we head home? Thank you 
very much for today!"
